The row is not clean sequence/modification verification because sequence_check is explicitly citation_link_only. The broader APD6 AP05803 sequence/activity identity is supported in a sibling final audit record by XML Table 1 row 3 and merged APD6 rows, so the literature-link row can remain confirmed only with that caution preserved.
